verdict.rationale: Instinct's privacy policy says that, once linked, it gets access to Google Drive, Docs, Sheets and Slides. One tester reports using it for work 'on our data room for LPs', a thin hint that it handles documents. Neither item shows the agent creating presentations or other files, iterating on edits, or producing exports. missing for 10: documented document/presentation creation, iterative editing workflow, export capability, hands-on evidence of file authoring quality
